title: CanvasXpress cxplot grammar snapshot
description: JSON Schema for the materialized cxplot grammar-of-graphics snapshot — the plain-value form of a figure's grammar (layers, scales, coordinates, facets). The live cxplot read-model is accessor-shaped (each slot is a function) and is not itself serializable; this schema targets its materialized projection. schemaVersion and materialized are the contract fields; the grammar slots mirror the figure's grammar. Lenient (additionalProperties allowed) where runtime detail is engine-internal.

schemaVersion.description: Semver MAJOR.MINOR of this grammar contract. NEW field (does not exist in the engine yet — added by ). Readers ignore unknown keys within a MAJOR line; a MAJOR bump ships a migration.

materialized.description: Marks a plain-value snapshot (as opposed to the live accessor-shaped meta.cxplot).

data.description: The post-wrangle data frame as an array of row objects (cx.getWrangled()).

dataPipeline.description: The data-grammar recipe: ordered dplyr/tidyr-style op records (group/segregate/transform/cluster) from cx.expandDataPipeline().

op.description: Verb name, e.g. group, segregate, transform, cluster.

mapping.description: Aesthetic bindings: aesthetic -> data column name (or null when unbound).

layers.description: Ordered geom layers from the geomRegistry preset for graphType plus any userLayers (addLayer).

geom.description: Geometry name, e.g. point, line, bar, area, boxplot, tile.

stat.description: Statistical transform, e.g. identity, count, bin, density, smooth.

when.description: Optional gating condition for the layer.

scales.description: Positional + aesthetic scales. Positional binders x/y/smp/var/size; aesthetic palette refs colors/shapes/sizes/patterns/linePatterns. In the LIVE object these carry methods (map/mapValue/toPixel); in the materialized form they are descriptors.
